itens.titulo: Is Bank of America's Stock a Buy Ahead of Its Q3 Earnings Report on Oct. 14?
itens.descricao: Is Bank of America's Stock a Buy Ahead of Its Q3 Earnings Report on Oct. 14? Yahoo Finance
trechos: In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
At a conference in mid-September, Moynihan told analysts that investment banking fees could be down 10% year over year, while trading revenue may come in flat.
"What we're seeing is the market generally in investment banking is down 10%," said Moynihan, referencing data from Dealogic, according to CNBC.
"We're not as well positioned in some of the businesses that have more activity, so we'll be down probably a bit more than that." So this will likely put net interest income (NII) into focus.
On the second-quarter earnings call, Bank of America's CFO Alastair Borthwick told analysts to expect full-year NII to be toward the upper end of its previous guidance of 6% to 8% annual growth.
Borthwick said that's based on modest loan and deposit growth and one rate hike in 2026.

itens.titulo: Dólar mantém maior cotação em 18 meses diante de tensões no Golfo e inflação nos EUA
itens.descricao: Dólar mantém maior cotação em 18 meses diante de tensões no Golfo e inflação nos EUA InfoMoney
trechos: O índice do dólar, que acompanha a moeda norte-americana em relação a seis outras divisas, subiu 0,37%, para 102,58, o maior nível desde abril de 2025.
Continua depois da publicidade Os futuros do petróleo Brent subiram 2,3%, para US$107,17 o barril, aproximando-se da maior cotação em duas semanas.
O petróleo Brent ainda está quase 45% acima do nível em que se encontrava antes do início da guerra iniciada pelos EUA e Israel contra o Irã.

Enquanto isso, a presidente do Fed de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o Federal Reserve deveria adotar “relativamente rápido” uma política restritiva para controlar a inflação, que ela considera mais generalizada.

Continua depois da publicidade Investidores vêm aumentando suas posições otimistas em relação ao dólar, que, na semana encerrada em 7 de outubro, totalizaram cerca de US$36 bilhões, ante US$8,4 bilhões há três semanas, em grande parte às custas do euro.
O Fed elevou os juros no mês passado pela primeira vez desde 2023 para conter a inflação.
Operadores do mercado financeiro estão precificando uma probabilidade de 78% de que o Fed mantenha as taxas inalteradas neste mês, ante 51% no mês anterior, segundo a ferramenta CME FedWatch.

Continua depois da publicidade “O foco real está nos dados do IPC desta semana, é provável que estejam em alta”, disse Marc Chandler, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Bannockburn Global Forex, em Nova York.

itens.titulo: Broadcom CEO Says Many AI Investors Have ‘No Clue,’ Likens Boom to a Casino
itens.descricao: Broadcom CEO Says Many AI Investors Have ‘No Clue,’ Likens Boom to a Casino Yahoo Finance
trechos: Broadcom Inc. CEO Hock Tan warned Monday that many artificial intelligence investors don't understand what they're buying, comparing their behavior to casino gambling even as his company forecasts $230 billion in annual AI chip revenue by fiscal 2028.
"A lot of investors have no clue what they are investing in," Tan said at an event in Singapore, Bloomberg reported.
He said investors were setting "very extreme expectations," only to discover that investing in AI was "almost like they are in a casino." Don't Miss: - A single bad hire can set a startup back years.

These 50 Must-Know Terms Can Help You Catch Up Fast Tan also questioned whether businesses were getting value from AI, comparing companies experimenting with the technology to children burning through arcade tokens without learning anything.
He said OpenAI's roughly $50 billion annualized revenue in September demonstrated strong demand, but its enormous training costs offered little indication of long-term profitability.
Broadcom's $230 Billion AI Bet Tan's warning comes as Broadcom enjoys extraordinary growth from the AI investment boom.
The company reported $16.7 billion in fiscal third-quarter AI semiconductor revenue, up 221% year over year, and expects $21.7 billion in the fourth quarter.
